description: Implementation of NuPlayerRenderer class handling media rendering, buffer queueing, EOS, flushing, and synchronization in Android media framework.

classes.name: NuPlayer::Renderer
classes.description: Handles media buffer queueing, EOS, flushing, synchronization, and position updates for media playback.

methods.name: queueBuffer
methods.description: Queues a media buffer for playback, either audio or video.

methods.name: queueEOS
methods.description: Queues an end-of-stream marker for audio or video.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the specified media queue (audio or video).

methods.name: signalTimeDiscontinuity
methods.description: Resets synchronization anchors on media discontinuity.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses media rendering.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes media rendering.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages for queue management, EOS, flush, and control commands.

methods.name: postDrainAudioQueue
methods.description: Schedules draining of the audio queue.

methods.name: signalAudioSinkChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the audio sink.

methods.name: onDrainAudioQueue
methods.description: Processes and writes audio buffers to the sink.

methods.name: postDrainVideoQueue
methods.description: Schedules draining of the video queue.

methods.name: onDrainVideoQueue
methods.description: Processes and renders video buffers.

methods.name: notifyEOS
methods.description: Notifies end-of-stream to observers.

methods.name: onQueueBuffer
methods.description: Handles queued media buffers, manages synchronization between audio and video.

methods.name: onQueueEOS
methods.description: Handles queued EOS markers.

methods.name: onFlush
methods.description: Handles flush requests, clears queues, and resets state.

methods.name: flushQueue
methods.description: Clears a media queue and notifies consumers.

methods.name: notifyFlushComplete
methods.description: Notifies that flushing is complete.

methods.name: dropBufferWhileFlushing
methods.description: Drops buffers if currently flushing.

methods.name: onAudioSinkChanged
methods.description: Resets position tracking on audio sink change.

methods.name: notifyPosition
methods.description: Updates current playback position.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Handles pausing of media playback.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles resuming of media playback.
